name: Pinnacle Security Crowd-Suppression Exoframe
description:
A powered exoskeletal frame worn over standard riot gear that amplifies the wearer's strength by a factor of three and provides full-body hardpoint armor coverage. The exoframe runs on a 4-hour fuel cell and features integrated crowd-control deployables — sonic emitters, chemical dispensers, and a riot shield mount.

The most aggressive crowd-control equipment legally deployable in GLMZ. A single officer in a Crowd-Suppression Exoframe can hold a corridor against a hundred people. The psychological effect of seeing one deployed frequently ends confrontations before they begin. When it doesn't, the results are documented in injury reports that run to hundreds of pages.
functionality: 3x strength amplification, integrated crowd-control systems, full armor coverage
what_it_says: You are the singular expression of overwhelming force, and the crowd will either disperse or discover what that means.
story_hooks: A Crowd-Suppression Exoframe is reported missing from Pinnacle's armory — 85,000 quanta of crowd-control weaponry in unknown hands, and the inventory was last verified three weeks ago.
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A towering, militaristic exoskeletal rig that transforms the wearer into an imposing riot-control colossus. Heavy articulated limbs with visible hydraulic pistons, reinforced shoulder pauldrons, and a pronounced chest plate housing weapon hardpoints. The silhouette reads as deliberately inhuman and intimidating—a fusion of medieval armor and industrial machinery.
physical_description.fit: Rigid over-frame construction that accommodates standard riot gear beneath. The wearer's natural body is almost completely enclosed; movement is amplified by servo-assisted joints rather than confined by the suit. Posture is forced upright and aggressive.
physical_description.primary_material: Ballistic-grade composite plating with reinforced titanium-alloy joint articulations. Pneumatic lines and hydraulic tubing run visibly across the frame. Impact-absorbing polymer padding at pressure points.
physical_description.texture: Utilitarian and industrial—hard composite surfaces interspersed with exposed mechanical components. Metal fittings are matte-finished to avoid glint. Rubber gaskets and reinforced seams throughout. No aesthetic softness.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal-gray primary with high-visibility safety orange accent striping on shoulder and leg articulations. Recessed black polymer around joint mechanisms. Warning labels and manufacturer insignia in stark white and red.
physical_description.closures: Hydraulic-locking hard-points and friction-fit mounting brackets. No traditional closures—the exoframe is secured to the wearer via integrated pressure-locks and center-of-mass alignment sensors.
distinctive_features: Modular hardpoint system on forearms and shoulder-mounted riot shield quick-release
Integrated sonic emitter grilles on chest plate
Chemical dispersal canister rack along spine
Visible 4-hour fuel cell module mounted on lower back
Heavy-duty servo-assist indicator lights (amber/red) embedded in arm plates
Pinnacle Security corporate logo stamped in 10cm letters across chest
Reinforced knuckle plating for impact amplification
Full visor with heads-up tactical overlay
Weathered scuff marks and impact scoring from deployed use
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 corporate enforcement equipment. The cost and deployment restrictions place this exclusively in the hands of sanctioned security forces and mega-corp private militaries.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearing this signals state-sanctioned authority and monopoly on legal violence. The wearer is not a person—they are an instrument. Street civilians associate it with oppression and control; corpo management associates it with order and profit protection.
physical_description.condition_typical: Operationally weathered but maintained to specification. Scuffed composite plating, minor dents from riot impacts, hydraulic fluid residue around joint seals. All systems functional. Psychological wear on the operator is not visible.
